categories.main_business_segments: China XLX Fertiliser Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and trading of chemical fertilizers and related chemical products. Its main segments include urea, compound fertilizers, methanol, dimethylformamide (DMF), melamine, liquid ammonia, urea solution for vehicles, and medical intermediates. The Group also engages in agricultural development and chemical new materials production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced coal gasification technology across all production facilities and holds patented controlled release urea production technology. It emphasizes technology-led development with research platforms such as the National Enterprise Technology Centre and Postdoctoral Research Station. Continuous R&D efforts focus on improving production efficiency, energy conservation, and product innovation, including high-efficiency fertilizers and integrated water-fertilizer solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: China XLX serves primarily the agricultural sector with its fertilizers, targeting large-scale farmers and industrial users requiring nitrogen fertilizers. It also supplies chemical raw materials to downstream manufacturing industries such as automotive, electronics, pharmaceuticals, and panel production. The Group's products are sold mainly to customers within Mainland China, with some overseas sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Mainland China with key production bases in Henan, Jiangxi, Xinjiang, and Guangxi provinces. It also has international business and trading subsidiaries and some overseas sales. The revenue is predominantly derived from the central, eastern, western, and northeastern regions of China, with a small portion from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: China XLX operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the chemical fertilizer supply chain, focusing on the production and sale of fertilizers and chemical intermediates. It also engages in agricultural development and provides integrated agricultural services, positioning itself as a key manufacturer and supplier within the fertilizer and chemical product value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus is on becoming China's most respected fertilizer enterprise by pursuing high-efficiency, high-end, and lean development. It adheres to a 'fertilizer as foundation, fertilizer and chemical side by side' strategy with a low-cost and differentiation operating model. R&D priorities include developing high-efficiency fertilizers, extending the chemical product chain, energy efficiency leadership, and innovation in marketing through big data and customer-centric approaches.
categories.revenue_model: China XLX generates revenue primarily through the manufacturing and sale of chemical fertilizers and related chemical products. It also earns income from trading, investment holdings, and services related to agricultural development. Revenue streams include product sales to industrial and agricultural customers, with some income from investment disposals and interest.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group positions itself as a leading player in China's fertilizer industry with significant scale advantages and a diversified product portfolio. It is recognized as a top 20 nitrogen fertilizer enterprise in China and holds industry leadership in energy efficiency. The company competes by leveraging low-cost operations, differentiated products, and strong brand and sales networks, although specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, China XLX reported revenue of approximately RMB 23.13 billion, a slight decrease of 1.5% year-on-year, with a net profit of RMB 2.01 billion, up 23% year-on-year. The Group maintains a gearing ratio of about 69.66% and has a workforce of 11,787 employees. It continues to expand production capacity and invest in new projects, demonstrating steady growth and resilience amid market fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China XLX emphasizes delivering high-efficiency fertilizers and differentiated chemical products that meet evolving agricultural and industrial needs. Its value proposition includes low-cost production, advanced technology adoption, energy efficiency leadership, and a customer-centric marketing approach supported by big data. The Group also focuses on sustainable and green development, aiming to create maximum societal value with minimal resources.
